title: A project with two net classes and three numeric rules
how: meta.version is 1; two classes (Default, Power); the three numeric rules are min_clearance 0.2 mm = 200000 nm, min_track_width 0.15 mm = 150000 nm and min_via_diameter 0.5 mm = 500000 nm
(the true/false rule is not a length); one text variable; the track width of Default is 0.25 mm = 250000 nm and of Power 0.5 mm = 500000 nm.
